notes.title: Ironbound Relics
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28995142/81e080524909a0e0f1e2e138a8047fa6ac0825ec.png[/img]

[h1]Welcome to Ironbound: Relics![/h1]
Secret Level Games and Making Fun, Inc. are excited to bring you Ironbound: Relics. This updated version of Ironbound brings powerful Relics that let players customize decks and play styles, and it revamps the economy to let players build a true collection of items through loot drops and crafting.

[h1]Relics:[/h1]
[b]Relics are a special class of trinkets that allow players to remove a token from a character's deck, replacing it with something else.[/b]

[list][h1]Berserker:[/h1][*]One Man Army replaces Frenzy.
[*]Will of Modi replaces Berserker Rage

[h1]Crusader:[/h1][*]Glorious Hymn replaces Crusade.
[*]Requiem replaces Vengeance.

[h1]Assassin:[/h1][*]The Sleeper Agent replaces Vendetta.
[*]Alluring Perfume replaces Blackout.

[h1]Witch:[/h1][*]Forbidden Fruit replaces Blood Pact.
[*]Blood Rite replaces Dark Pact.

[h1]Pirate:[/h1][*]Death or Glory replaces Mutiny.
[*]Riding the Storm replaces Explosive Bullets.
[/list]

[h1]Economy:[/h1]
Ironbound: Relics introduces rarities, coffers and crafting. Items are classified as common, rare, epic, legendary, or relic. Coffers drop four items and guarantee one item of their rarity. So a Rare Coffer guarantees a Rare item, an Epic Coffer guarantees an Epic item, and so on. Coffers cost 1,000 gold and can be earned in-game as well. Items may be salvaged into Iron Shards that can be used to forge items of choice. 
Gold is earned in Ranked and Arena play, with a cap of 10 game wins per day that give Gold. This means that players can play and continue to rise in rank, but only the first 10 victories will give Gold, after that each victory awards 5 Iron Shards.

Arena tickets can now be purchased only with gold.

The Premium Account now gives 3x more gold per win and 100 Iron Shards each day you login. Players who have purchased Premium Accounts in the past will retain their Premium status and gain the new bonuses.


[h1]Other Changes:[/h1][list]
[*]Adjustments to rank values and rewards for Ranked play mode. 
[*]All characters now start at 200 HP.
[*]Practice mode rewards updated to new economy.
[*]Improvements to account creation and login.
[*]Tutorial streamlined.
[*]Improvements to game's menus and tooltips.
[*]Hints added to menus.
[/list]

notes.title: Client Patch 1.3.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28995142/5a9e66f44fbb142be9470f2e0df2acd700037c51.jpg[/img]

[h1]Game changes and fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Starter Pack store item was replaced by Gold Chest, which can be bought repeatedly.
[*]Implemented achievements.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Parry activates if the weapon is ready at the end of the turn, even if it was used. It also applies multiple times per turn again.
[*]Backstab: 5-10 damage up from 3-7.
[*]Ambush: +10 damage when not Stealth, up from +4.
[*]Reinforce: cost 3 AP up from 2 AP.
[*]Thor's Hammer: 5-10 damage, down from 5-15.
[*]Seal of Reckoning: 5% crit per AP, down from 10%
[*]Arena Shiv of Mastery: gain 1 damage when Mastery triggers, down from 2.
[*]Steel Hilt: +2 start AP.
[*]Kurgan Blade: +4 damage, up from +3.
[*]Magic Barrier: cost 2 AP down from 3 AP and +1 start AP.
[*]Morgana's Veil: effect no longer stacks with itself.
[*]Muzrub: 35% critical chance, up from 30%.
[*]Scepter of Toth: lowered condition from 25 damage to 20 damage.
[*]Golden Kopesh: lowered condition from 30 damage to 25 damage.
[*]Vampiric Shard and Lesser Vampiric Shard: effect applies to next attack, instead of for the entire turn.
[*]Blood Moon: 20% critical chance, down from 25%.
[*]Wall of Montu: 2 damage over 2 turns, down from 3 damage over 3 turns.
[/list]

[h1]New items:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Kurgan Decapitator (2H axe, Berserker only): This weapon has +4 damage if you have less HP than your enemy, and -5 damage when you have more.
[*]Stalker Great Axe (2H axe, Berserker only): For each turn you don't use this weapon, it gains 3 damage for the next attack.
[*]Stalker War Baton (2H staff, Witch only): For each turn you don't use this weapon, it gains 3 damage for the next attack.
[*]Stalker Longsword (1H sword): For each turn you don't use this weapon, it gains 2 damage for the next attack.
[*]Stalker Hacker (off-hand axe, Berserker only): For each turn you don't use this item, your main weapon gains 2 damage for the next attack.
[*]Stalker Shiv (off-hand dagger, Assassin only): For each turn you don't use this item, your main weapon gains 2 damage for the next attack.
[*]Stalker Orb (orb, Witch only): For each turn you don't use this item, your main weapon gains 2 damage for the next attack.
[*]Stalker Shield (shield): For each turn you don't use this item, your main weapon gains 2 damage for the next attack.
[*]Berserker Cleaver (2H Axe, Berserker only): Each time you critical hit, you have a 30% chance to gain Enrage until your next turn.
[*]Sorcerer Staff (staff): Each time you critical hit, you have a 30% chance to gain Focused Mind until your next turn.
[*]Crusader Smasher (1H hammer, Crusader only): Each time you critical hit, you have a 30% chance to gain Last Stand until your next turn.
[*]Sorcerer Dagger (dagger, Witch only): Each time you critical hit, you have a 30% chance to gain Focused Mind until your next turn.
[*]Foe Hammer (1H sword, Crusader, Assassin, Witch): While you are in your class special state, you have +5 magic damage.
[*]Stinger (1H sword): While you are in your class special state, your attacks cannot be blocked, evaded or parried.
[*]Last Stand Fortress (tower shield): Each time you block the entire damage, you have a 50% chance to reflect damage equal to your defense.
[*]Sorcerer Orb (orb): Each time you critical hit with this weapon, you have a 30% chance to gain Focused Mind until your next turn.
[/list]

notes.title: Client Patch 1.1.9
notes.content:
[h1]Game changes and fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]If a match isn't decided after 40 turns, it is automatically declared a draw.[/b]
[*][b]Practice missions give rewards once for each player class, instead of once per account.[/b] Existing mission progress has been reset, so you can replay all the difficulties.
[*]Arena games can be played against bots for all ticket types, if the ticket is bought with real money. Bots are still restricted to the first two ticket types, if the ticket is bought with gold.
[*]Removed passive play checks and deck exhaustion damage.
[*]Added info buttons in the Customize and Practice menus, explaining various things which are not immediately obvious.
[*]Fixed: Amulet of Mastery could trigger all the time, not only in Focused Mind.
[*]Fixed: the AI never used Disarm.
[/list]

[h1]General balance changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Items which cost exactly 1000 gold have full resell price.
[*]Tweaked prices for a number of items.
[*]Draupnir: removed passive bonuses and gives 300 more gold flat, instead of 3x more gold.
[*]Arcenstone: gives 50 more gold flat, instead of 50% more.
[*]Vicious Mithril Axe: +4 damage while Enraged, up from +2.
[*]Vicious Adamantium Axe: +5 damage while Enraged, up from +3.
[*]Vicious Thorium Axe: +6 damage while Enraged, up from +4.
[*]Spirit Bear Bones: added passive bonus: +1 main hand damage.
[*]Draconian Seal: added passive +1 main hand damage bonus.
[*]Mirror of Ra: passive damage and defense bonuses increased to 2.
[*]Tyrfing: removed disabled trinket slot.
[*]Svalinn: removed disabled trinket slot.
[/list]

[h1]Arena balance changes:[/h1]
[b]Cruel Gladiator[/b]
Hatchet of Cruelty: critical hits also make the main-hand cost 0 AP, on top of re-enabling it.

[b]Cruel Knight[/b]
Signet of Cruelty: add 2 damage over 2 turns on the enemy on critical hit, instead of healing 5 HP.

[b]Master Knight[/b]
Redesigned weapon and shield.

[b]Cruel Ambusher[/b]
Shiv of Cruelty: ignore shield, parry and evade applies only to its own attacks.
Ring of Cruelty: heal 3 HP on critical hit, down from 5.

[b]Cruel Conjurer[/b]
Dagger of Cruelty: +3 magic damage on critical hit, down from 5, and restore 1 AP, down from 2.
Orb of Cruelty: lower token cost by 2 on critical hit, down from 1.
Gem of Cruelty: heal 3 HP on critical hit, down from 5.

[b]Resilient Conjurer[/b]
Staff of Resilience: disable 2 tokens on critical hit, down from 3, and has +1 start AP, down from 2.

notes.title: Client Patch 1.1.5 - The Arena!
notes.content:
[h1]The Arena is here![/h1]
This update introduces a new multiplayer game mode called Arena. In this mode, everyone uses one of the predefined Arena item sets, which are designed to have roughly the same strength. There are 3 sets for each class, and they are all available regardless of your current inventory or performance on the ladder. Only your skill matters! (Ok, luck also plays a little role.)

In order to play in the arena, you must first purchase a ticket. [b]One ticket allows you to play one game.[/b] If you win, you get back the ticket price, plus a reward. There are 5 ticket options, with increasing prices and rewards. If the game is a draw, both players keep their tickets. The ticket is only used when you start the game, so if you hit Play and the matchmaker cannot find an opponent (or you cancel the search), you will keep your ticket.

If you don't want to risk gold, you can also buy tickets with real money. In this case, winning gives you the same gold reward, but doesn't refund the ticket price.

For the first two ticket options (100 gold and 500 gold), if the matchmaker cannot find another player after 60 seconds, it will give you a bot. Bots are not available for the more rewarding options (because they don't play that well).

If you find any problems or potential imbalances with the Arena sets, please report them on the forum. We may tweak the sets in the near future based on player feedback and data we gather from live games.

Have fun!

[h1]Other changes and fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added 2 more bots at rating 3000.
[*]Added some more daily quests.
[*]The server replaces all the completed quests once per day, instead of only 1.
[*]Fixed: wrong resell prices for Adamantium Staff, Adamantium Tower, Great Adamantium Axe, Wanderer Shield and Warden Seal.
[*]Fixed: network games timed out if it took more than the ping interval to load the loading screen.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Tweaked the completion values for some daily quests.
[*]Witch Mastery: gain 1 AP per action, down from 2.
[*]Black Venom: 4 damage over time, up from 3.
[*]Seventh Sun: 4 damage over time, up from 3.
[*]Pendant of Cunning: +30% critical hit chance, up from +20%.
[*]Iron Fist: +1 defense.
[*]Blade of Ra: 4 damage, down from 5.
[*]Sol Invictus: 20% chance to trigger, down from 30%.
[*]Cursed Ankh: removed passive damage bonus and lowered start AP bonus to 1.
[*]Gram: 50% chance to trigger, up from 30%.
[*]Ardent Cleaver: +1 damage over time.
[*]Faith +1: 30% chance to trigger, up from 20%.

[*]Blood Bargain: 2 damage per action, down from 3.
[*]Jormungand Scale: also gives +2 to bonus from Blood Bath, not just to damage.
[/list]

notes.title: Free To Play!
notes.content:
[h1]This patch makes Ironbound completely free to play[/h1]

We have removed the "demo" mode which caused so much confusion, and all content can now be accessed for free, without restrictions. Instead of the one-time unlock fee we had before, we now offer a gold booster account upgrade, which gives 3 times more gold for ranked victories, therefore allowing players to progress faster. The booster can be purchased for 1 day, 7 days or permanently.

We've adjusted the economy to account for this change. We kept the ranked victory reward at 100 gold, but increased the prices for items and character upgrades. Players who have the booster should find that the amount of effort necessary to obtain a new item is comparable to the situation before this patch.

All the accounts which were unlocked before this patch have been given the permanent booster, plus 10,000 gold to smooth over the transition. We've also reset everyone's multiplayer stats (rating, rank, perks and match history).

We hope this change will make the game more accessible and encourage more people to play on the ladder. Over the next few weeks we will add daily quests and a new game mode, so stay tuned!

[h1]Selected changes and fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The insignia at the top of the multiplayer menu changes based on the current rank.
[*]Gaining a new multiplayer rank is rewarded with gold.
[*]Tokens played by opponent face the player and have a small delay before disappearing.
[*]Fire Chant: 2-5 damage, up from 1-5.
[*]Added hint popups for various events, e.g. when a perk is upgraded and must be activated.
[*]Fixed: keyboard input didn't work on Mac when the game was full screen.
[*]Better titles on the buttons in the main menu.
[/list]

[h1]New items[/h1]
[list]
[*]Cursed Ankh (trinket, all classes): Each time you attack with a weapon, both players gain 1% critical hit chance permanently.
[*]Jar of Horus (trinket, Assassin and Witch): Each time you gain a token from your enemy's deck, deal its AP cost as damage.
[*]Book of the Dead (trinket, all classes): Deal 10 damage to yourself and ignore damage from your enemy until your next turn.
[*]Mirror of Ra (trinket, all classes): While you have less HP than your enemy, both players have a 20% chance to miss on all weapon attacks.
[*]Kurgan Blade (2H sword, Berserker and Witch): This weapon has +3 damage if you have more HP than your enemy, and -3 damage when you have less.
[*]Golden Khopesh (1H sword, all classes except Berserker): Each time you deal 30 or more damage with this weapon, double your damage for its next attack.
[*]Scepter of Toth (1H hammer, Crusader): Each time you deal 30 or more damage with this weapon, heal for the same amount.
[*]Blade of Ra (1H sword, all classes): You can attack multiple times per turn, but each attack costs +1 AP.
[*]Scythe of Anubis (2H sword, Berserker and Witch): Each time you die due to self damage, resurrect with 30 HP.
[*]Wall of Montu (shield, all classes except Witch): Each time you block the entire damage, deal 3 damage per turn over 3 turns to your enemy (stacking).
[*]Pretorian Mark (trinket, Crusader): Each time you suffer a critical hit gain Last Stand for the next turn.
[*]Crown of Thorns (trinket, Crusader): Each time you deal damage during your opponent's turn, gain 2 weapon damage for your next turn.
[*]Light of Dawn (trinket, Crusader): Each time your Mastery perk triggers, gain a Healing Word token.
[*]Fenrir Fang (trinket, Berserker): Each time your Mastery perk triggers, gain an Overpower token.
[/list]

notes.title: Free To Play!
notes.content:
[h1]This patch makes Ironbound completely free to play[/h1]

We have removed the "demo" mode which caused so much confusion, and all content can now be accessed for free, without restrictions. Instead of the one-time unlock fee we had before, we now offer a gold booster account upgrade, which gives 3 times more gold for ranked victories, therefore allowing players to progress faster. The booster can be purchased for 1 day, 7 days or permanently.

We've adjusted the economy to account for this change. We kept the ranked victory reward at 100 gold, but increased the prices for items and character upgrades. Players who have the booster should find that the amount of effort necessary to obtain a new item is comparable to the situation before this patch.

All the accounts which were unlocked before this patch have been given the permanent booster, plus 10,000 gold to smooth over the transition. We've also reset everyone's multiplayer stats (rating, rank, perks and match history).

notes.title: Client Patch 1.0.20
notes.content:
[h1]Game changes and fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]New combat log.
[*]The inventory and combat log can be scrolled with the mouse wheel.
[*]Changed the classification icons for Dark Ritual (magic damage), Regenerate (buff), Sorrow (debuff) and Blood Pact (buff).
[*]The Windows installer creates a shortcut in the "all programs" section of the Start Menu.
[*]Fixed: broken game when Legbiter performed a critical hit on an enemy with no off-hand item.
[*]Fixed: bug which caused some "lost connection to server" errors during the matchmaking phase.
[*]Fixed: the staff critical hit description mentioned "cards" instead of "tokens".
[*]Fixed: Dragon Tail had the same effect as Mason Scepter.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Crusade: cost 0 AP down from 2 AP.
[*]Shadow Pierce: cost 3 AP down from 4.
[*]Magic Missiles: cost 4 AP down from 5.
[*]Freezing Blast: 10-15 damage up from 5-10.
[*]Dark Ritual: 15-20 damage up from 10-15 and cost 8 AP down from 9.
[*]Seduce: disable 2-7 tokens up from 1-7 and cost 2 AP down from 3.
[*]All Quick off-hand weapons: lowered damage by 1 and can only trigger once per turn.
[*]Most 2H axes: lowered extra damage gained on crit.
[*]Unicorn Horn: 20% crit chance down from 30%.
[*]Kelpie's Eye: 20% crit chance down from 30%.
[*]Blightslayer: reflects damage at most once per action, so it doesn't run into a reflect loop when both players have it.
[*]Brute Armband: can only be used by Berserker.
[*]Ring and Signet of Binding: 5 charges up from 3 and added bouses: +5% crit chance and +1 start AP.
[*]Dragon Egg: added bonus: +1 off-hand damage.
[*]Arcane Strom Crystal: added bonus: +5% crit.
[*]Morgana's Veil: only changes the cost of tokens, not all actions. Resell price temporarily set to 100%.
[*]Rune of Power: new effect: each time you suffer a critical hit, you have a 50% chance to heal for the amount of damage taken. Resell price temporarily set to 100%.
[*]The Ulfberht: 15% crit chance up from 10% and 6 damage up from 5.
[/list]

[h1]New items:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Silver Censer (trinket, Crusader): Remove one enemy buff and heal 10 HP.
[*]Holy Censer (trinket, Crusader): Remove all buffs from both players. Heal both players for 10 HP.
[*]Seal Of Judgement (trinket, Crusader): Each time you play a Judgement Blow token, remove one enemy buff.
[*]Grey Worm (trinket, Assassin): Each time you play a Numbing Poison token, remove one enemy buff.
[*]Holy Shell (shield, all classes except Witch): Each time you suffer a critical hit, heal 2 HP per turn over 3 turns (stacking).
[/list]

[h1]Ratings reset![/h1]
[b]Multiplayer ratings will be reset as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*]Players at rating 2000 or above will be reset to 1000.
[*]Everyone else will be reset to rating 100.
[/list]
​​​​​​​

notes.title: Client Patch 1.0.17
notes.content:
[h1]Client changes and fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Implemented the Settings menu, including an option for playing full screen. The game will start full screen the first time you run it after this update.
[*]Players receive 100 gold after completing each tutorial challenge and a 200 gold bonus after completing the entire tutorial.
[*]Increased the account creation bonus to 500 gold (from 200).
[*]Made the tutorial challenges easier by lowering the enemy HP to 60 and changing some bot weapons. 
[*]Added a new multiplayer bot at rating 2000 (Agnea).
[*]Trinkets like Steel Hilt or Colossus Grip no longer disable the other trinket slot. Instead, they require two trinket slots. Therefore, it is no longer possible to use one of these trinkets with a weapon which disables slots, such as Tyrfing. Also, disabled slots are cumulative now, so when both weapons disable 1 slot (for example, Tyrfing and Svalinn), no trinkets can be equipped.
[*]Fixed: Blessed Band gave +2 defense instead of the stated +3, and the combat log said "gained 1 defense".
[*]Fixed: Tribal Might said "gained 1 weapon damage" in the combat log, instead of the actual 3.
[*]Fixed: unclear description for Beast Fang (it didn't say it only triggers on its own crits).
[*]Fixed: incorrect pop-up description for Shadow Pierce in the Witch tutorial.
[*]Fixed: stuck games if a player lost the connection due to an exceptional event (e.g. the computer rebooting).
[/list]

[h1]Game balance changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Lion: 4 defense down from 5.
[*]Steel Hilt: cannot be used by Assassin anymore.
[*]Merciful Fate: removed damage and crit bonuses.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello Steam users,

We are very excited to be able to bring Ironbound to Early Access and finally show you what we've been working on. Since there are still a few rough edges, here are some tips to make sure you have an enjoyable experience:

[list]
[*][b]Don't skip the tutorial![/b] Ironbound should be easy to pick up, but there are some things that are not immediately obvious. It only takes about 15 minutes to go through all 4 tutorial challenges.
[*][b]Don't jump straight to multiplayer![/b] It's better to play some solo challenges first and get yourself acquainted with the class you're going to use. The first few solo stages are easy to win, and the gold you'll gain will allow you to buy better gear or upgrade your character, which will translate into better chances in online games.
[*]Conversely, if you've defeated a few solo stages but get stuck, try multiplayer. Winning online matches gives you gold that you can use to upgrade your equipment. Also, creating an account (which is required for online play) gives you a gold bonus.
[*]Don't miss the right hand side tabs in the customize character screen. That screen will show your inventory when you open it, but there are two more tabs next to the portrait: Character Upgrades, where you can level up, and Perks, where you can select which character perk is active.
[*]While playing a match, you can open the settings menu by clicking the round button on the left edge of the table (the one with the gears on it). This works during the tutorials too, even if a hint popup is currently showing.
[*]The game window is resizable! If it's partially covered by the taskbar, or too large, or too small, you can resize the window by dragging any corner or edge. There's no full screen option at the moment, but it's coming soon.
[/list]

We'll address most of these things through in-game hints in the near future. If you have more questions, maybe our [url=https://forum.makingfun.com/showthread.php?14604-FAQ]FAQ[/url] or [url=https://forum.makingfun.com/showthread.php?14603-Roadmap]Roadmap[/url] already have the answer you're looking for. If not, please write to us on the Steam discussion forum, or our [url=https://forum.makingfun.com/forumdisplay.php?135-Ironbound]dedicated forum[/url]. We're also very eager to hear feedback on game balance, difficulty, technical aspects, or any other game-related subject, so please use any of the available channels to contact us. 

Have fun!
